messages:
maya: Heads-up from research: users asked for an audit indicator in the notify preview so they can see why channels are muted (scheduled window, auto-snooze, or rule). Suggest a tiny history icon that opens a compact timeline.
owen: Love that. Timeline could show "muted by schedule at 22:00", "auto-snoozed due to repeat alerts". Keep it condensed (timestamps relative). :calendar:
sara: Accessibility: timeline must be keyboard navigable and entries should have aria-labels like "Muted by schedule, returns in 3 hours". Don't rely on color alone.
maya: Visual idea: a stacked-dot icon next to each channel chip; hover expands a mini-popover with the timeline and reason. On mobile, tapping the chip opens the same popover.
owen: Also on counts: product prefers wording. Instead of active/suppressed let's standardize on "active/muted" across UI and docs. Less technical.
sara: Microcopy for popover header: "Mute history" and list lines like "12:03 PM — muted by schedule (maintenance) — returns in 3h". Include an "Unsnooze" inline action.
maya: Implementation note: ensure popover content is in DOM when open and hidden with aria-hidden when closed. Use role="dialog" with focus trap for keyboard users.
infra-bot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.com/alerting/mute-history-2167899999 includes popover + keyboard flows. :shipit:
maya: Small copy tweak: change header from "Muted channels" to "Channels muted for this alert"  clearer in multi-tenant orgs.
owen: UX question: should muted channels count toward the "notified channels" total? Research says users want both numbers. Proposal: show "Notifies 2 active (3 muted)" in header.
sara: Also ensure auto-muted entries show a short reason: "auto-muted due to rate limit" so engineers can triage. Keep the tooltip concise.
maya: I'll update the mock, add the aria notes to the spec, and tag @product for final copy sign-off.
